      <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
        <p class="psjustify" >The easiest and most direct route is through Fortaleza Airport, which is served by flights from Europe, such as those operated by TAP or Air France. For those preferring a closer option, Jericoacoara has a smaller airport with limited domestic flights. Our driver will be waiting for you at the airport to take you directly to us. After a journey of approximately 3 hours from Fortaleza or 1 hour from Jericoacoara, you’ll be welcomed to our little paradise. This way, you’ll arrive quickly and on the same day, ready to rest and start your first kite session the very next morning.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
        <p class="psjustify">Currently, the best and most affordable connections are offered by the Portuguese airline TAP, with direct flights from Lisbon to Fortaleza. There are several daily flights from multiple major cities in Europe. Visit the airline's website here: <a href="https://www.flytap.com" target="_blank">www.flytap.com</a></p>
        <p class="psjustify">Air France also operates a daily direct flight <small class='text-muted'>(except Sundays)</small> from Paris to Fortaleza. Click here to search for Air France flights: <a href="https://www.airfrance.de" target="_blank">www.airfrance.de<a/></p>
        <p class="psjustify">As a low-cost airline, Air Europa is the only carrier offering flights from Madrid to Fortaleza with a stop in São Paulo. Visit Air Europa's website here: <a href="https://www.aireuropa.com" target="_blank">www.aireuropa.com<a/></p>
